summary: Tested server-side drafts/autosave system for crowdfunding platform 4Luis. All backend endpoints (PUT/GET/DELETE /api/admin/drafts/{type}/{ref_id} and GET /api/admin/drafts) and frontend integration working correctly. Server drafts allow admin to recover unsaved work across devices.
passed_tests: Backend: PUT /api/admin/drafts/journey_edit/{journey_id} - creates/updates draft, returns {status:'saved', updated_at:...}
Backend: GET /api/admin/drafts/journey_edit/{journey_id} - returns draft with data, draft_type, reference_id, user_id, timestamps
Backend: GET /api/admin/drafts - lists all drafts for admin
Backend: PUT /api/admin/drafts/journey_create/new - works for journey_create type
Backend: All draft endpoints return 401 without admin token
Backend: Draft timestamps (created_at, updated_at) included in responses
Frontend: Edit form changes trigger autosave - 'Alteracoes por guardar' indicator appears
Frontend: After 2.5s debounce, 'Sincronizado' indicator confirms server sync
Frontend: Server draft verified via API after autosave
Frontend: Cancel button clears server draft (verified 404 after cancel)
Frontend: Server draft recovery - banner shows 'Rascunho recuperado do servidor'
Frontend: Form populated with server draft data on load
Frontend: 'Descartar' button restores original journey data
Frontend: Create Form autosave - 'Rascunho guardado' indicator appears
Frontend: journey_create/new draft created on server after autosave
Frontend: Create form Cancel clears server draft
critical_code_review_comments: Server draft endpoints correctly use upsert pattern to handle create/update in single PUT
Draft endpoints properly exclude MongoDB _id from responses via projection
Frontend autosave uses dual-layer approach: localStorage (instant) + server (async 0.5s after)
Proper cleanup: clearAutosave() deletes both localStorage and server draft on cancel/save
context_for_next_testing_agent: Server-side drafts fully working. Key endpoints: PUT/GET/DELETE /api/admin/drafts/{draft_type}/{reference_id}, GET /api/admin/drafts. Draft types: 'journey_edit' (for editing existing journey), 'journey_create' (for new journey with ref_id='new'). Frontend uses debounced autosave: 2s to localStorage + 0.5s additional for server sync. Key data-testids: autosave-indicator (shows 'Sincronizado'), autosave-restore-banner (shows 'Rascunho recuperado do servidor'), autosave-keep-btn, autosave-discard-btn, edit-btn-journey_{id}, edit-cancel-btn, create-journey-btn, input-name.

features_verified.details: All CRUD operations work correctly with proper auth enforcement
Changes sync to server with 'Sincronizado' indicator
Banner shows 'Rascunho recuperado do servidor' when server draft exists
Clicking Descartar restores original journey data and deletes draft
New journey form syncs to journey_create/new draft on server
Both edit and create form cancel buttons delete server drafts
